search_filters.positionStartDateMax_note: Age is NOT searchable. Career-start proxy: contacts whose earliest position predates 2006, or college grad year <= 1992 (grad 1992 => born ~1970 => 56 in 2026).

qualification_gates.gate_1_location: US person-location (search country filter) — hard fail
qualification_gates.gate_2_seniority: Current OR prior senior title — hard fail
qualification_gates.gate_3_age_floor: Estimated age >= 55 OR retired — hard fail
qualification_gates.gate_4_assets: Inferred rollover assets >= $250,000 — hard fail below threshold
qualification_gates.gate_5_dnc: Federal + NY DNC scrub before any delivery — hard fail

scoring_notes.months_since_job_change: 12-48 months since change = peak orphaned-401(k) window. <12 too fresh, >48 decays.
scoring_notes.prior_jobs_count: Job-hopping (many stints <3yr) is NEGATIVE — non-vested, small balances. 2-4 long-tenure prior roles is ideal.
downscores: lifelong single employer (no orphan to roll)

routing.age_55_to_59_49: NURTURE — tracked with maturity_date = DOB + 59.5y; auto-promote to SELL at maturity
routing._note: Three nulls above = open v3 decisions. Pipeline runs without them; delivery module reads them when set.

credit_gate.rule: Search broad (free), enrich narrow (credits). Never auto-enrich.
